title: Block Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🧱️block plugin (3-app: ◻2d, 🧊️3d, 🖐️5d, plus shared module + manifest/artifact crate — 23 crates total) from the old multi-app crate layout to the new single-crate taxonomy layout, following CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/TEMPLATE.md and the GIS 2-app precedent extended to 3 apps. Determine artifact count from actual document-schema boundaries in the old code (not naming guess). Full baseline tests, wire-format proofs per app, cargo check/clippy/test on the new crate via temp workspace overlay, then delete old crates and hand off registrar block.
summary:
W2 migration of 🧱️block: 23 Rust crates (bundle `semio-s-plugin-block` + 3 apps' 7-module sets each [block2d/block3d/block5d] + a non-constitutional shared record-types module) merged into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-block` at `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧱️block/📦️packages/🦀️rust/`, wired from a plugin-root `📦️lib.rs` by explicit full-path `#[path]` declarations.

Structure: THREE separate artifacts (one per app, no sharing) — `🗿️artifacts/◻2d` (block.2d, edits one NodeKind), `🗿️artifacts/🧊️3d` (block.3d, edits one ObjectKind), `🗿️artifacts/🖐️5d` (block.5d, edits one PartKind unifying both 2d/3d presentations) — each with all of {🦀️component,🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr,⚙️engine} (📡️protocol renamed to 📡️spr). Plus a plugin-root `🫀️core/🦀️component.rs` non-constitutional cross-artifact kernel holding the record types genuinely shared across all 3 artifacts (BlockKindIdentity/BlockAttribute/BlockAuthor/BlockCompatibilityRule/BlockRepresentation/BlockCamera2d/BlockCamera3d/BlockMeta) — determined by reading the old `block_shared` crate's own doc comment, not guessed. Three apps: `🎛️apps/◻2d` (10 commands/6 groups, 1 window), `🎛️apps/🧊️3d` (26 commands/9 groups, 1 window + 5 shared-window options, plus an app-level `🦀️world.rs` for scene compute needing both document+config), `🎛️apps/🖐️5d` (8 commands/5 groups, 2 windows). All 3 Command enums rebuilt with `app_commands!`; all `DocumentApp::handle` impls collapsed to `command.dispatch(doc, cfg)`.

Verification (via temporary nested `[workspace]` overlay, removed at handoff; `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools` was required to route around a system-wide Xcode-license-gated `cc` that blocked ALL fresh linking repo-wide, not just this crate): `cargo check` clean (zero warnings for this crate), `cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2` clean, `cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2` produced a real `.wasm` component, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, `cargo test` 102/102 green (baseline was 48 passing pre-migration + 16 tests that existed but couldn't run because 2 of 3 old ui crates were broken at HEAD, TEMPLATE §12.3's Ok(/Fault paren-corruption bug, forward-fixed here — same pattern as batch-1's cad/vcs/shooting/sourcing/animate). Wire format proven byte-identical: pre-migration hex dumps of all 10 Block2dCommand + 26 Block3dCommand + 8 Block5dCommand rows diff with ZERO differences against post-migration dumps (matched by exact printed-text key, not just position, to survive test-list-length differences). Two real bugs were caught and fixed BEFORE reaching that clean diff: I had over-annotated `HoverSurface`/`PlaceVortex`'s position/normal fields with `#[dsl(coord)]`/`#[dsl(dir)]` and `SetCamera`'s camera field with `#[dsl(block)]`, none of which existed on the original hand-written Command enum — these silently changed the wire bytes/printed form until removed. Taxonomy audit clean (no `📡️protocol` segment survives, manifest builds, taxonomy tree structurally complete).

Old crate dirs deleted (`🛂️manifest`, plugin-root `🔨️modules/🤝️shared`, all 3 apps' `⚡️implementations`+`🔨️modules`); the 6 example fixtures were relocated to `🎛️apps/<app>/📚️examples/` (verified byte-identical) before deletion. Root workspace is now red on exactly block's 23 dangling member lines until the registrar pass.

No cross-cutting dependents found outside the plugin directory (checked `dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep` and `dsl/📇️registry` specifically per instructions, and grepped the whole repo for `semio-s-app-block`/`semio-s-plugin-block`/`block_2d`/`block_3d`/`block_5d`/`block_shared` — zero hits outside `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧱️block/` and root Cargo.toml's own member-list lines). No cross-plugin `[dev-dependencies]` on block found either.
